qualification_policy.rule: An expert is verified only when every required check has observed evidence for the current engine major/minor.

techniques.title: Inspect task-relevant project assets and dependencies
postconditions: Exact target classes, dependencies, graph topology, and reusable assets are supported by live evidence.

techniques.title: Compose surface-constrained traversal from sensing, movement state, and animation presentation

architecture.state_owner: The character or traversal component owns authoritative sensing, timers, movement state, and enter/update/exit/cancel transitions.
architecture.animation_consumer: The current AnimBlueprint or a linked animation layer consumes gameplay state; it does not own wall detection or replace the character movement system.
architecture.movement_policy: Use a custom movement mode for sustained traversal when prediction/replication matters. A bounded prototype may use another mode only when its limitations are declared and proven.
architecture.sensing_policy: Use trace or shape-sweep observations with explicit collision channels, normal/geometry acceptance, reachability, and contact-loss hysteresis.

postconditions: The intended input and contact-duration threshold reach the public traversal activation path.
Valid surfaces enter traversal and invalid surfaces, early release, contact loss, interruption, and repeated activation restore a valid movement state.
The selected animation roles are skeleton-compatible, contextually accepted on the target character, consumed by the current animation architecture, and visibly play in PIE.
Movement, camera, interaction, combat, and adjacent animation behavior pass regression checks.

sources.claim: Unreal trace queries provide collision-aware hit observations used to sense world geometry.
Movement Components update actor movement and provide the engine movement architecture that traversal must integrate with.
Character Movement supports custom movement modes and networked movement prediction responsibilities.
Animation State Machines organize pose states and transition rules inside Animation Blueprints.
Linked Animation Blueprints and layers allow animation logic to be organized without replacing the owning AnimBlueprint.

techniques.title: Stage and apply Blueprint graph operations with postcondition readback
postconditions: Every requested node and pin link exists after readback.
Touched Blueprints compile with zero new errors.

techniques.title: Select animation assets by semantic role and measured compatibility
postconditions: Candidate motion meaning matches the declared role.
Skeleton, duration, samples, root-motion policy, provenance, and license pass.

sources.claim: Animation Sequences contain sampled skeletal transforms and are tied to Skeleton assets.
Root-motion acceptance requires measured root-bone motion, sequence extraction settings, AnimBlueprint policy, movement mode, and runtime capsule behavior.

techniques.title: Compose montage sections and slot groups through the AnimGraph
postconditions: Each montage role uses a declared slot.
Each slot receives a pose and reaches Output Pose.
Runtime playback returns a positive duration.

sources.claim: Montages use sections, slots, and slot groups; separate body regions require AnimGraph slot composition.

techniques.title: Retarget animation through selected source and target rigs
postconditions: User-selected target skeleton/mesh is recorded.
Source and target chains map without unresolved required limbs.
Exported sequence uses the target Skeleton and passes motion preview checks.

sources.claim: IK Rig retargeting transfers animation between different hierarchies using source/target rigs, chains, poses, preview, and export.
UE 5.8 retarget operations can copy or generate root motion and must identify source and target root drivers.

techniques.title: Build and validate a Pose Search schema/database/query path
postconditions: Schema targets the selected Skeleton.
Database contains compatible role-appropriate motion data.
Motion Matching reaches Output Pose and produces runtime selections.

sources.claim: Motion Matching composes Pose Search schema channels, a database of animation data, and runtime query nodes; locomotion data requires root motion.

techniques.title: Acquire, cache, import, and validate external assets with provenance
postconditions: HTTPS source identity, license, hash, local cache path, and Unreal destination are recorded.
Imported asset exists and passes type-specific validation.

sources.claim: UE FBX import uses FBX 2020.2 and allows selecting an existing Skeleton for compatible skeletal imports.

techniques.title: Select FBX import mode from asset contents and target compatibility

accept: materials/skeleton/physics outputs match the declared contract
AnimSequence Skeleton identity equals the selected Skeleton

when: FBX hierarchy differs from every acceptable target
accept: Source animation is imported on that Skeleton
Target is selected before retarget execution

when: source has armature-only data or unsupported structure
accept: Converted file has measured skeleton/animation content
Lineage and tool license are recorded
Retry creates expected Unreal asset classes

postconditions: The selected mode explains why its expected Unreal classes should be produced.
Every imported animation is read back against the caller-selected Skeleton.
A failed mode becomes repair evidence, not a successful recipe.

sources.claim: Skeletal mesh import and existing-Skeleton selection are distinct FBX pipeline choices.

techniques.title: Run task-specific PIE and automation assertions
postconditions: A matching PIE scenario records passed assertions and observed evidence.
No new relevant log errors occur.
Generated test state is cleaned up.

sources.claim: Unreal Automation supports unit, feature/PIE, content stress, functional, input-driver, and screenshot tests; tests must not assume state and must clean up.

techniques.title: Compare current tutorials, guides, documentation, and primary examples
postconditions: Every adopted claim retains URL, author/provider, engine version, prerequisites, license, and retrieval date.
Conflicting approaches are resolved against live project constraints and official API behavior.

sources.claim: Epic provides versioned documentation, samples, and tutorials that can anchor engine contracts.

techniques.title: Add a reflected C++ wrapper only for a proven Python capability gap
postconditions: Live reflection proved the gap.
Built module exists before enablement.
Python reflection exposes the method and its self-test returns structured evidence.
